svg.title: Driver Dreamer — Signature GT — Red Header
svg.desc: A Signature GT typography experiment preserving the selected White Emotion page composition and untinted Ferrari 458 Italia photo. The direct red header uses the contextual logo and white navigation. White Avenir Next Bold CHASE THE is paired with red lowercase Snell Roundhand Bold feeling. The script baseline is lifted to keep its full swash and descender in the clear sky. Small interface copy remains Futura; the red second line of the collection heading repeats the genuine script face. The page includes one white editorial section and a direct red legal footer, with no logo backing plates.

g.text: FOR THE CARS THAT STAY WITH YOU

text.tspan: Make a place for your next dream.

g.text: RED EXTERIOR / TAN INTERIOR / SILVER WHEELS
